{{Quote|Watch it! Get away, little bark eaters! Oh, ''kvark.''|translated=1|Latara, upon being tackled by Gorneesh and Urgah's children|<ref name="TTJ" />}}
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the combined misbehavior of a '''Dulok cub''' and the child's [[Unidentified Dulok cub 1|brother]] and [[Unidentified Dulok cub 2|sister]] proved so intolerable that [[Urgah]], the child's [[Parent/Legends|mother]] and the [[Queen/Legends|queen]] of a [[Gorneesh's tribe|tribe]] of [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]] who lived in the [[Dulok Swamp|swamp]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]], demanded that her [[Marriage/Legends|husband]], [[King/Legends|King]] [[Gorneesh/Legends|Gorneesh]], find a babysitter. The King sent out [[Scout/Legends|scouts]], who kidnapped the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Latara/Legends|Latara]] to take care of the Dulok cubs. The Ewok's stewardship of the three siblings proved short, however; while the toddlers joined their village as they watched a group of visiting [[Entertainer|performers]] known as the [[Travelling Jindas]], Latara's friends rescued her from her duty over the three youngsters. Unlike Gorneesh's other children, the Dulok pup went about without any body covering save a typical coat of [[Color/Legends|green]] Dulok [[Hair/Legends|fur]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I'm sure you know how we Duloks love to torture Ewoks. Well, your torture will be the most exquisite of all: babysitting the Dulok brats.|translated=1|Gorneesh, to Latara|<ref name="TTJ" />}}
[[File:UrgahUltimatum-TTJ.png|thumb|left|The Dulok child joined two other toddlers in driving their mother to demand a babysitter.]]
[[Urgah]], [[Queen/Legends|queen]] of a [[Gorneesh's tribe|tribe]] of [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]] who lived in a [[Dulok Swamp|swamp]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]], [[Reproduction/Legends|bore]] at least three [[Youngling/Legends|cubs]]<ref name="TTJ" /> by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="TTJ" /><ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> children sired by her [[Marriage/Legends|husband]], [[King/Legends|King]] [[Gorneesh/Legends|Gorneesh]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the three pups were toddlers; although [[Unidentified Dulok cub 1|two]] of the [[Unidentified Dulok cub 2|children]] went about with some clothing, while the third was unadorned.<ref name="TTJ" />

In 3 ABY, the naked Dulok child joined the other two toddlers in harassing their [[Parent/Legends|mother]] while she attempted to do laundry in the family hut; the unclothed Dulok stood atop the [[Gender/Legends|matriarch's]] shoulders and pulled furiously at her [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. The experience drove Urgah to threaten Gorneesh: either find a babysitter for the children or go hungry. The King accordingly enlisted [[Unidentified Dulok (X)|two]] [[Unidentified Dulok (O)|guards]] to kidnap a caregiver from nearby [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], a [[City/Legends|settlement]] of [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]]. The pair returned with a [[Color/Legends|gray]]-furred female Ewok named [[Latara/Legends|Latara]], a newcomer whom Gorneesh considered a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] fit for the [[Torture/Legends|torture]] of watching the children. The three Dulok pups greeted their new babysitter by embroiling her in an impromptu wrestling match.<ref name="TTJ" />

The new babysitting arrangement did not last long, however: Latara's friends&mdash;the Ewoks [[Paploo/Legends|Paploo]], [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]], [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]], and [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket W. Warrick]]&mdash;infiltrated the Dulok village by disguising themselves and joining the [[Travelling Jindas]], a group of wandering [[entertainer]]s who were admitted into the Dulok swamp to put on a show. After the three Dulok cubs dragged Latara to the front row, the toddlers joined their fellow Duloks in lampooning the performers. However, the [[Jinda/Legends|Jinda]] [[Magic/Legends|magician]] [[Trebla]] pulled Latara onto the stage to serve as his assistant, leaving the children with their parents. Although the Ewok interlopers inadvertently revealed their presence during the performance, the Jindas managed to abscond with Latara in tow.<ref name="TTJ" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:DulokBratlingDogpile-TTJ.png|thumb|right|The Dulok child roughhoused with the other children, much to their babysitter's annoyance.]]
{{Quote|&hellip;miserable, monstrous, misbehaving brats! I can't stand it anymore! If I don't get a babysitter, you don't get any supper!&raquo;<br />&laquo;Hmm. Don't worry, my dear. I've just had an evil inspiration.|translated=1|Urgah's ultimatum regarding her children gives Gorneesh an idea|<ref name="TTJ" />}}
Urgah and Gorneesh's child resembled other members of the Dulok [[Species/Legends|species]] in that the pup had brown eyebrows, green fur, a brown [[Nose/Legends|nose]], and gray skin.<ref name="TTJ" /> As a young child in 3 ABY,<ref name="TTJ" /><ref name="BTM" /> however, the Dulok only stood [[Limb/Legends|knee]]-high to a typical Dulok of 1.35 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="TTJ" /><ref name="height" /> The toddler's [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] were white. When Urgah demanded a babysitter for the child, the pup only had one visible [[Tooth/Legends|tooth]], a bottom canine.<ref name="TTJ" />

The child's demeanor betrayed the cub's penchant for mischief and misbehavior. Indeed, older Duloks felt that watching the pup was like torture; in the incident that prompted Urgah to demand a babysitter, for instance, the youngster was perched atop the Queen's shoulders, yanking on her topknot and cackling. When the babysitter Latara showed up at the Dulok Swamp at a later occasion, the toddler joined a sister and a brother in attacking her in what devolved into a four-way wrestling match. Only a visit by the Travelling Jindas calmed the cub down.<ref name="TFTEW">''[[Tales from the Endor Woods]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Writer [[Bob Carrau]] and director [[Raymond Jafelice]] featured Gorneesh and Urgah's child<ref name="TTJ" /> in the [[October 5]], [[1985]],<ref name="SWC 66">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref> episode of the [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] cartoon series, ''[[The Travelling Jindas]]''.<ref name="TTJ" /> In [[2004]], the Dulok siblings were included in the [[Star Wars home video releases|DVD]] release ''[[Tales from the Endor Woods]]'', which edits their episode together with three others into a feature-length film.<ref name="TFTEW" /> Although the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Ewoks (1985) 13|''Ewoks'' 13]], published in [[May]] [[1987]] by [[Marvel Comics]], includes a child of Gorneesh and Urgah named [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Boogutt]], any correlation between the children from the animated series and the comic book remains unclear.<ref name="E13">[[Ewoks (1985) 13|''Ewoks'' (1985) 13]]</ref>
